source_exposure: Publication methods, published findings and bibliographic metadata reviewed. No new row-level quantitative assay outcomes, count matrices, supplementary outcome workbooks or prediction arrays acquired by this agent.

facts.locator: Methods: Joint library tested in HepG2, K562, and WTC11 cells
facts.claim: Common 60,000-element joint library; candidate enhancer selection uses earlier activity bins; promoter selection uses earlier across-cell mean activity bins plus the top 1,000 variable promoters. Controls are also selected.
facts.interpretation_limit: Fixed selected panel, not random genomic ascertainment.

facts.locator: Methods: Lentiviral infections and DNA and RNA barcode sequencing
facts.claim: Three independent infections per experiment; joint library intended MOI 50 HepG2 and 10 K562/WTC11; collection after three days.
facts.interpretation_limit: Different cell contexts include delivery/experimental conditions, not an isolated TF intervention.

facts.locator: Methods: Replicates, normalization and RNA/DNA activity scores
facts.claim: Activity derived as log2 RNA/DNA; remove estimates with fewer than 10 independent barcodes; each replicate normalized to its median before averaging three replicates.
facts.interpretation_limit: Full-library source preprocessing includes the eventual evaluation panel. Published endpoint is relative activity, not absolute transcripts/cell.

facts.claim: Source ESS first z-score transforms each cell activity vector, then subtracts the element across-cell mean. Final publication assigns the full ESS table to Supplementary Table 10.
facts.interpretation_limit: Pairwise published base-activity differences are not the source ESS estimand. Do not silently import source ESS rescaling into a train-only model claim.

facts.locator: Fig5; Methods: Data pre-processing and model training; interpreting motifs
facts.claim: Source already predicts cell specificity using multi-task sequence models, groups each element across cells in one CV fold, and interprets cell-specific motifs.
facts.interpretation_limit: General cell-specific sequence prediction is not new; a stricter fixed-small-model benchmark is a bounded reanalysis.

facts.locator: Results: Sequence-based models predict activity; Characterization of cell-specific factors
facts.claim: Reported cell-specific motif priors include HNF4A/G in HepG2, GATA-TAL1 in K562, POU5F1-SOX2 in WTC11; source warns of shared-family recognition and pretrained test-locus annotation exposure.
facts.interpretation_limit: Motif family association is not unique TF identification or causal binding evidence.

facts.locator: Design/construct sections; Methods: Lentivirus packaging, titration, and infection
facts.claim: Same 171-base candidate library tested with wild-type versus mutant-integrase lentivirus in HepG2; native loci not restored; collection timing and intended viral copy numbers differ.
facts.interpretation_limit: Integration/episomal contrast does not isolate native chromatin causality.

facts.locator: Methods: design of enhancer library; feature generation; regression
facts.claim: Reuses existing 2,440-element Inoue array and fits sequence/biochemical lasso models to activity and loess residual assay contrasts. Genomic 2,236 candidates reused for orientation/length designs.
facts.interpretation_limit: New measurements are not independent sequence-panel selection. Differential assay prediction already established.

facts.locator: Results/discussion: assay comparisons and orientation; Methods: normalization
facts.claim: Transcribed 3-prime UTR inserts can reflect RNA stability/splicing; feature multicollinearity limits causal interpretation; source records poorer-quality replicate exclusions in two nonintegrating designs.
facts.interpretation_limit: RNA mechanisms require matching reporter/transcript architecture; correlation does not isolate causal features.

facts.locator: Methods: library generation; cell transfection; analysis
facts.claim: Variant MPRA in NA12878 and NA19239 LCLs and HepG2 using 150-base genomic allele inserts and minimal promoter; original data GSE75661.
facts.interpretation_limit: Variant effects differ from whole-fragment activity; eQTL selection and correction scope require accounting.

facts.locator: Methods: MPRA screen and analysis; Introduction/discussion: functional follow-up
facts.claim: K562 and GATA1-overexpressing K562 variant MPRA; selected endogenous editing and target-gene follow-up; source quantile-normalizes replicates.
facts.interpretation_limit: Factor overexpression can alter broader cell state; reporter association is not a complete gene/phenotype mechanism.

facts.locator: Article author lists; methods library generation; data availability
facts.claim: Agarwal, Inoue, Klein and Kircher have overlapping investigators/assay lineage; distinct accessions establish distinct study records, not unrelated laboratory replication or genomic disjointness.
facts.interpretation_limit: Exact sequence, locus and control overlap requires the designed sequence records.

facts.claim: Inoue 2017 has a 2018 corrigendum PMID 29717003; Tewhey 2016 has a 2018 correction PMID 29474912. Existence verified, content not obtained.
facts.interpretation_limit: No assumption about correction scope or quantitative validity; resolve before quantitative reuse.

questions.question: Can fixed sequence-by-cell features improve held-out-locus same-fragment contrast prediction beyond shared slopes and cell intercepts?
questions.falsifier: No useful improvement under declared loss/uncertainty, or gain attributable to split overlap or source mixture.

questions.question: Do prespecified TF-family features add context-contrast information beyond composition?
questions.falsifier: No incremental held-out gain, outcome-selected features, or category/composition-dependent result.
missing_evidence: TF occupancy/perturbation and directed motif validation

questions.question: Is apparent predictive improvement robust across predeclared source classes rather than dominated by controls or outcome-enriched categories?
questions.falsifier: Gains restricted to selected classes or unstable across grouped folds.
missing_evidence: Independent source sampling for population claims

questions.question: Are predicted cell contrasts consistent across independent infection estimates?
questions.falsifier: Direction or improvement unstable across infection estimates or precision strata.

novelty_status: General context-aware sequence prediction is prior art; no new biological mechanism demonstrated; global novelty of any future reanalysis remains unestablished.
uncertainties: Correction text/scope for Inoue 2017 and Tewhey 2016 not obtained.
Exact genomic/sequence/control overlap between candidate new panel and Kircher2019 not measured in this review.
Zenodo preprint workbook numbering cannot be identified with final-publication numbering from its filename alone.
Source assay endpoint relative to full-library median is not prospective raw-count processing.
